name: certify
description: Plataforma de Emision y Gestion de Credenciales Digitales

scripts.backup: npm run backup:db && npm run backup:storage
scripts.restore:storage: rm -rf storage/certificates storage/logos && tar -xzf storage/backup.tar.gz -C storage
scripts.restore: npm run restore:db && npm run restore:storage
scripts.pull:sync: npm run down && npm run restore && npm run up:build
scripts.snapshot: tar -czf database/snapshot.tar.gz -C database data && tar -czf storage/snapshot.tar.gz -C storage certificates logos
scripts.reset: npm run down && npm run snapshot && rm -rf database/data storage/certificates storage/logos && npm run up:build
